top_signals.title: Russian hackers hijack hotel Wi-Fi networks to spy on travelers, Microsoft says
top_signals.summary: Russian state-sponsored hackers have been compromising hotel Wi-Fi networks around the world to steal travelers' login credentials and infect devices with espionage malware, Microsoft said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Anchor Funds Depend On Sticky Assets: Nandakumar
top_signals.summary:
Amrita Nandakumar, president of Vident Asset Management, joins Scarlet Fu and Eric Balchunas on "Bloomberg ETF IQ." They discussed the growing volume of ETF launches and how issuers should center their strategies around anchor funds.
 (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Atlas Air finalizes Air Atlanta investment
top_signals.summary:
Atlas Air has completed a previously announced deal to take control of Air Atlanta’s freighter fleet and become a minority shareholder in the airline.

The post Atlas Air finalizes Air Atlanta investment appeared first on FreightWaves.

top_signals.title: Cyber Command plans Silicon Valley office to drive innovation
top_signals.summary: The outpost will have its own director, though no one has yet been named for the post, and support the command’s nascent Cyber Warfare Innovation Center (CIWC).

top_signals.title: Bithumb sets 2028 IPO timetable as it overhauls internal controls
top_signals.summary: The South Korean exchange plans to seek preliminary listing review in 2027 while overhauling controls after a February crediting error.
